original_test_intent: Write one approved sensor's selected threshold fields, verify the exact applied vector and intended alert-boundary behavior, and restore the original thresholds without changing hysteresis or event enables.
original_method: Preserve Sensor/Event 0x04/0x26. Because the Master request has no payload, the Review layer requires target sensor, set-mask and all six ordered threshold bytes from Project SPEC.
manual_activity: Owner chooses a writable non-protected sensor, approves the exact mask/vector in raw and engineering units, reviews downstream alert/action impact and confirms restoration before one write.
required_inputs: Authoritative SDR sensor number, units and conversion
Exact threshold set mask with reserved bits zero
Safe monotonic ordering and project limits
safety_requirements: Do not guess sensor, mask or values
Validate raw-to-engineering conversion and monotonic order
Reject fixed/unsupported thresholds or active incident
agent_execution_scope: Capture current thresholds, hysteresis, events and SDR conversion
Validate proposed raw and engineering-unit vector
Restore original vector under approved plan
engineer_actions: Approve sensor/mask/vector, limits and behavioral oracle
Own monitoring risk and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly refuses the incomplete Master request, but the standard operation is packageable once the exact sensor/mask/vector is provided.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After fresh approval, use protected `ipmitool raw 0x04 0x26 <sensor> <set-mask> <LNC> <LC> <LNR> <UNC> <UC> <UNR>` exactly once with reserved mask bits zero; read back using 0x04/0x27.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original netfn/cmd, incomplete source body, attended time 10 and machine time 5 remain unchanged; no omitted bytes are inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Construct a sensor-specific vector from SDR units, enforce support/range/order, capture baseline, perform one confirmed write, verify all fields and alert behavior, then restore exactly.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing payload and complete safety/acceptance transaction only in the Review layer.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only threshold inventory is prerequisite/partial evidence and cannot satisfy the original Set Sensor Threshold purpose.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bad thresholds can suppress real faults, generate false critical events or trigger downstream fan/power actions; restoration cannot erase alerts emitted during the test.

project_override_considerations: A vendor/Redfish interface is acceptable when it writes the same sensor fields and provides equivalent mask, units, readback, alert behavior and restore evidence. Raw 0x04/0x26 remains separate coverage unless waived.
expected_evidence: Fresh approval with target/sensor and exact mask/vector
SDR identity, units/conversion and writable capability

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master specifies only netfn/cmd for a state-changing operation, omits every required data byte and accepts command success, while clearing the evidence needed to assess alert impact. DeepSeek identifies incompleteness but offers no transaction. Review preserves source and adds the required package.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended function and standard request layout are identifiable. Sensor/vector/support, approval and restoration are project execution inputs, so review can complete without authorizing an incomplete write.

review_improvement: Makes the threshold payload, unit conversion, writable mask, safety order, behavioral oracle, readback and exact restoration auditable while forbidding incomplete execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Threshold ordering and sensor conversion determine whether a raw byte is safe. A command completion cannot prove the correct sensor fields changed or that alert actions remain acceptable. The test therefore needs a complete approved vector, before/after readback and controlled alert observation, which requires a packaged confirmed mutation.
